query: European EV battery imports United States duties

statements.text: We expect the Commission to place provisional duties on Chinese EV imports by early July.
Other critical minerals will have the same tariffs, starting even earlier – this year.
Tariffs on EVs under Section 301 will rise from 25% to 100% in 2024.
The EU chose to launch an anti-subsidy investigation into EVs rather than opt for an anti-dumping probe, which would have allowed it to impose higher tariffs.

Should it determine that China-based producers have benefited from subsidies in ways that harm EU-based manufacturers, it could place provisional countervailing duties on China-origin EV imports anytime from now until July 3, and final duties by early November.
Tariffs on lithium-ion EV batteries will rise from 7.5% to 25% in 2024
